articles.headline: Cooke scores 22, No. 24 West Virginia women beat Northwestern 66-53 at Greenbrier Tip-Off
articles.description: — Gia Cooke scored 22 points, Zahirah Walton had 16 points and six steals and No. 24 West Virginia never trailed as the Mountaineers beat Northwestern 66-53 on Friday at the Greenbrier Tip-Off.
